metaDescription: Kevin reacts to Whitney Webb's prediction that a bank cyberattack could push users onto CBDCs and stablecoins, tying it to the GENIUS Act and BlackRock.
summary: Kevin reacts to a Whitney Webb interview clip in which she predicts a cyberattack on banks could justify moving people onto a new digital currency. Webb suggests banks could blame hackers for lost deposits and return the money as USDC or tokens. Kevin links this to reports of unvetted AI agents accessing US bank accounts, recent outages at Navy Federal, United Airlines and JP Morgan, and the GENIUS Act taking effect January 18, 2027. He notes that BlackRock's Larry Fink is a top holder of several affected companies. Kevin predicts a push for AI regulation before January, and advises viewers to take money out of banks.

keyMoments.label: Get Your Money Out of Banks
